item.title: His memory resets every 30 seconds. A look inside his 1990 diary shows what he never forgot.
item.description: In 1985, the life of British musicologist Clive Wearing changed forever. After contracting herpesviral encephalitis, a rare virus that attacked the memory-forming regions of his brain, Wearing was left with what is considered the most extreme case of amnesia ever recorded. item.description: Navigating the complexities of brain health as we age can be a daunting experience. item.description: When it comes to national politics, Americans are fiercely divided across a range of issues, including gun control, election security and vaccines. item.title: 3D scanning and shape analysis help archaeologists connect objects across space and time to recover their lost histories
item.description: Today the world of Egyptology faces a silent crisis – not of looting, although that plays a part, but of disconnection. item.title: Pregnant diver jumps in to help a bleeding dolphin near her boat. Then, the entire pod surrounded her.
item.description: Nicole Isaacs was not planning to become a wildlife rescuer that day. She was out on the ocean off Los Angeles with a friend when a dolphin appeared alongside their boat, barely moving, covered in deep red gashes."Are you hurt?" Isaacs asked, almost reflexively, leaning over the side. When the dolphin rolled onto her side and revealed the wounds, Isaacs' voice broke: "Oh, no! I think [she's] hurt! She got bit. item.title: Plastic pollution is a global mess and bamboo could be our way to dig out of it
item.description: Plastic pollution is one of the most pressing environmental issues we face today. Conventional plastics are hard to replace because they are durable and inexpensive to produce. Now, scientists are turning to nature to find new solutions.Researchers in China have developed a plastic made from bamboo. item.title: Part star, part supporting actor, Robert Duvall lit up 1970s American cinema and kept going
item.description: Robert Duvall, who has died at the age of 95, will be remembered for a glittering career that saw him appear in two of American cinema’s most iconic films.
